anomalies.description: Two individuals engage in physical combat on a bed, with one person being thrown or pushed onto the bed and struggling while another actively attacks them; a third person (child) observes from the side.
A larger individual appears to be assaulting a smaller, less mobile person lying on the bed, consistent with abuse of a helpless victim; the victim is pinned or struck repeatedly while others watch.
